title: Flaky real_web_workspace scenarios: function timeout and panel-render assertion fail intermittently in CI

comments.author: home
comments.text: Seen 2026-10-20 on PR 622 (spec-only change, so unrelated): the conversation CI job failed two scenarios in features/real_web_workspace.feature, one with a function timeout and one with a panel-render assertion; rerunning the failed job passed. Also seen locally on 2026-10-19 by the Board-panel worker: one real_web_workspace scenario fails on a Mac whose OS is in dark mode because the scenario reads the OS color scheme. Make the scenarios deterministic (fixed color scheme in the harness, no wall-clock dependence) and find the timeout's cause.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Root cause and fix (PR 626, merged). (1) Function timeouts: the browser harness cleanup called process.kill on the Chrome process group and tolerated only ESRCH; an EPERM escaped the finally block before the HTTP server closed, so the tsx process stayed alive after printing its result and the step hit the 60 s timeout (it also leaked Chrome profile dirs, GBs of disk). Reproduced: harness alone hung 3 of 16 times under load. (2) 'false !== true' on the Context/Files panel: the step read the panel text once the custom element existed, before React committed its content (createRoot render is async); same shape for the hidden-tab active=false read and tab badge. (3) OS dependence: prefers-color-scheme, locale, timezone and fixed sleeps. Fix is harness-only: robust cleanup and explicit exit, waits on observable readiness with 20 s bounded timeouts and messages naming the missing state, color scheme/reduced motion/UTC/en-US pinned. Before: 3 of 16 feature runs passed with 4 copies at once. After: 16 of 16 under the same load, and 30 of 30 consecutive with 2 copies at once. CI on the PR was green.
